errors.evidence: The categories on the horizontal axis, "Recall," "Precision," and "F1 Score," are not arranged in alphabetical order.
The vertical axis is unlabeled. "F1 Score" is a category on the horizontal axis.
The visible range of the vertical axis is from 40 to 100. Stating that it ranges from 0 to 100 is an assumption about the full scale, not what is explicitly depicted.
The tick labels on the vertical axis are shown at 40, 60, 80, and 100, which represents 20-unit intervals, not 10.
The description uses the word "approximately" but then provides the exact numerical value labeled on the chart. This phrasing is imprecise and is repeated for all nine data values.
